Download maven artifacts

Download one file of an artifact: &lt;groupId&gt;:&lt;artifactId&gt; names it, --version picks
the release (default: the release, else the latest, that maven-metadata.xml
lists) and the file is &lt;artifactId&gt;-&lt;version&gt;.jar (--classifier and --extension
change that). The checksum next to the file (.sha256, .sha512, .sha1) is
fetched and the file is verified against it; a file with no published checksum
is stored but reported as not verified.

--download-token takes the short-lived token the web panel hands to a browser
for ONE file (Maven is the only format that has them). It opens just that file
of that repository, so rp needs --version, skips maven-metadata.xml and the
checksum (other paths the token does not cover), sends no other credential,
and never prints the token.

```
rp download maven <groupId>:<artifactId> [flags]
```

## Options

```
      --classifier string       Classifier of the file (sources, javadoc, ...)
      --dir string              Directory to store the file in (created when missing) (default ".")
      --download-token string   Download token of the web panel for this one file (needs --version)
      --extension string        File extension (default "jar")
      --force                   Replace the file when it already exists
      --repo string             Repository to download from (required)
      --version string          Version to download (default: the newest the format knows)
```
